discussion.body: Temple of Life. Seat: south of King's Sea, above Tierso. World aspect: harvest, birth, field healing, the right of a crop to come back. Breskshire food levy in Act 1 is already borrowing against this aspect. Sigil: Root. Combat: heal, ward, blight invert. Civic: Padon and Tierso feed the human empire. Failure: blight timer on the south peninsula; towns empty toward Light; Ysolde's work becomes triage. Relation: Life eats Water and fears Fire. It does not fuel the Cannon. Party link: Ysolde.
